title: SUPERNAP Thailand breaks ground in Chonburi
description: A JV of SUPERNAP International with CPB Equity, Kasikorn Bank, Siam Commercial Bank and True IDC began a US$300m Tier IV data centre at Hemaraj Chonburi Industrial Estate.
significance: Planted the first large wholesale campus in the Eastern Seaboard, the corridor that later drew most approvals.

title: Alibaba Cloud opens first Thai data centre in Bangkok
description: Alibaba Cloud opened its first Thai data centre with one availability zone, announced in October 2021.
significance: Third Chinese cloud with local capacity, after Huawei and Tencent.

title: AWS announces Thailand region and US$5bn plan
description: AWS said it would open a three-zone Bangkok region and invest more than US$5bn (about 190bn baht) over 15 years.
significance: First US hyperscaler region commitment, the anchor pledge in Thailand's cloud-hub pitch.

title: Gulf, Singtel and AIS start GSA data centre build
description: The GSA Data Center JV (Gulf 40%, Singtel 35%, AIS 25%) began building a 20MW-plus facility near Bangkok for 2025 operations.
significance: Thailand's largest power producer moved into data centres, tying generation and compute in one group.

title: Microsoft announces first Thai datacenter region
description: At a Bangkok AI event Microsoft said it would build a Thailand datacenter region and train 100,000 people in AI, with no amount given.
significance: Completed the set of three US hyperscalers committing to Thai regions.

title: NEPC approves 2,000MW direct PPA pilot
description: The National Energy Policy Council approved a pilot letting invited large investors, mainly data centres, buy renewable power directly via third-party grid access, capped at 2,000MW.
significance: First crack in EGAT's single-buyer model, built to meet hyperscaler clean-power demands.

title: Cabinet sets up Cloud First Policy committee
description: The Cabinet approved a committee chaired by the Digital Economy minister to drive the Cloud First Policy for government agencies and a regional cloud hub.
significance: Made the state an anchor cloud buyer and framed data centres as a national hub strategy.

title: Gulf Edge and Google Cloud agree sovereign cloud
description: Gulf Edge became Google Cloud's first managed Google Distributed Cloud provider in Thailand, offering air-gapped sovereign cloud in Gulf data centres.
significance: A local power group became the sovereign wrapper for US cloud technology.

title: Google pledges US$1bn for Thai data centre and cloud region
description: Google said it would invest about US$1bn (36bn baht) to build a data centre in Chonburi and a cloud region in Bangkok.
significance: Second US hyperscaler capex pledge; its Chonburi site sits in the EEC gas and grid corridor.

title: BOI approves Google and GDS hyperscale projects
description: BOI approved 32.8bn baht for Alphabet's Quartz Computing and 28bn baht for GDS unit Digitalland Services, both in Chonburi.
significance: US and Chinese-origin hyperscale capital approved side by side in the same province.

title: Nvidia and Siam.AI sign Thai sovereign cloud deal
description: During Jensen Huang's Bangkok visit, Nvidia partnered with Siam.AI to build Thailand's first sovereign cloud on Nvidia hardware.
significance: Tied Thai 'sovereign AI' to US chips, the same supply chain later probed for diversion.

title: Utility Green Tariff 1 opens at 4.21 baht/kWh
description: Utilities opened registration for UGT1, about 2bn kWh of unspecified renewable power from EGAT hydro at 4.21 baht/kWh on one-year contracts.
significance: First grid-supplied green power product data centre buyers could actually sign.

title: AWS Asia Pacific (Thailand) region goes live
description: AWS launched its three-zone Thailand region and restated more than US$5bn of long-term investment.
significance: First US hyperscale region live in Thailand.

title: BOI: 2024 applications hit 1.14tn baht, digital tops
description: BOI said 2024 applications reached 1.14tn baht (about US$33bn), with the digital sector, including data centres and cloud, top by value at 243.3bn baht.
significance: Data centres became the headline of Thailand's investment story.

title: AI Diffusion Rule puts Thailand in Tier 2
description: The US AI Diffusion Rule placed Thailand, like most of Southeast Asia, in the capped middle tier for advanced AI chip access.
significance: Would have capped Thai access to US AI chips; rescinded before it took effect.

title: BOI approves TikTok 126.8bn baht data hosting project
description: BOI approved TikTok Pte's 126.8bn baht data hosting project, due to operate in 2026, plus a 3.25bn baht Siam AI cloud project.
significance: First mega approval for a Chinese platform's data hosting in Thailand.

title: TikTok says US$8.8bn for Thai data centres over five years
description: A TikTok vice president said the company would invest US$8.8bn in Thai data centres over five years.
significance: Largest pledge to date, from a Chinese firm, weeks after the US AI chip tiering.

title: BOI approves Beijing Haoyang 300MW Rayong campus
description: BOI approved 90.9bn baht across three data centres, led by Beijing Haoyang's 72.7bn baht, 300MW site in WHA Eastern Seaboard 4, Rayong.
significance: Largest single MW approval, Chinese-owned, in the Rayong gas and petrochemical belt.

title: US rescinds AI Diffusion Rule
description: Commerce rescinded the AI Diffusion Rule two days before compliance and promised a replacement.
significance: Removed the Tier 2 cap but left Thailand's chip status in limbo.

title: BOI approves Chinese-backed Stratus 203MW Rayong project
description: BOI approved 23.7bn baht for Stratus Technology, an affiliate of Beijing's CNISP Group, for 203MW at CPGC Industrial Estate, Rayong.
significance: Added to a cluster of Chinese-owned capacity in Rayong.

title: US drafts AI chip licence rule for Malaysia and Thailand
description: Bloomberg reported a draft Commerce rule requiring licences for advanced AI chip shipments to Malaysia and Thailand to curb diversion to China.
significance: Thailand was singled out as a diversion risk; the rule was never finalised.

title: Bridge Data Centres breaks ground on 200MW Chonburi site
description: Bain-backed Bridge Data Centres broke ground on QHI01 in Chonburi, planned for up to 200MW.
significance: The BDC model built for ByteDance in Johor arrived in Thailand.

title: 1H 2025 data centre applications reach 521bn baht
description: Data centre applications in 1H 2025 totalled 521.2bn baht (US$16.1bn) from 28 projects, including about 740MW in six named May and June approvals.
significance: Half a year of applications exceeded the whole 2024 digital sector.

title: China's Galaxy Data Center plans US$2bn Rayong AI campus
description: Galaxy Data Center, part of China's Tianjin Zhengxin Group, announced US$2bn for a green AI cluster with about 150MW IT at Silicon Tech Park, Ban Chang.
significance: Third major Chinese-owned Rayong project in five months.

title: BOI approves four more data centres worth US$3.1bn
description: BOI approved four data centres worth US$3.1bn, including DAMAC Digital's 84MW and a 200MW local hyperscale project, plus fast-track measures.
significance: Gulf capital became a recurring source of Thai data centre approvals.

title: DayOne lifts Chonburi CTP1 to 300MW, eyes 1GW
description: DayOne added land to take its Amata City Chonburi campus to 300MW of power capacity and signed an MoU for a second plot toward 1GW.
significance: First gigawatt-scale campus ambition in Thailand, from a GDS spin-off.

title: BOI approves seven data centres; 2025 total tops 728bn baht
description: BOI approved 96.88bn baht for seven data centres (True IDC, GSA, Stellar DC, Freyr) and said 2025 applications reached 36 projects above 728bn baht (US$23.1bn).
significance: Confirmed data centres as the largest promoted sector of 2025.

title: Google Cloud Bangkok region opens
description: Google Cloud opened a three-zone Bangkok region as part of its US$1bn Thailand investment.
significance: Second US hyperscale region live in Thailand.

title: Super Micro co-founder indicted over server diversion
description: SDNY charged Super Micro co-founder Wally Liaw and two others over about US$2.5bn of Nvidia-based servers allegedly routed via a Southeast Asian intermediary to China; Bloomberg sources later named a Bangkok firm.
significance: Two months later Bloomberg's sources tied the case's 'Company-1' to a Bangkok firm.

title: ERC launches UGT2 at about 4.56 baht/kWh
description: The ERC launched UGT2, ten-year contracts for power from new solar, wind and biogas plants at about 4.56 baht/kWh with bundled certificates.
significance: Gave data centres a long-term, source-specific green power option.

title: Hormuz closure exposes Thailand's LNG exposure
description: IEEFA said gas supplies 66% of Thai power, LNG 27% of gas and 28% of cargoes pass Hormuz; LNG prices rose from US$11 to US$23.50/MMBtu and 0.6GW of coal was restarted.
significance: Showed new data centre load is ultimately met by imported LNG at the margin.

title: True IDC breaks ground on 250MW EEC AI campus
description: CP Group's True IDC, partnered with GIP-BlackRock, began a 77bn baht (about US$2.36bn) 250MW modular AI campus in the EEC, phase one by 2027.
significance: Largest Thai-operated project, with US infrastructure capital behind it.

title: Microsoft pledges over US$1bn for Thai cloud and AI
description: Microsoft committed more than US$1bn for 2026 to 2028, building with Gulf, AIS, CP Group, True and True IDC.
significance: Microsoft chose Thailand's biggest conglomerates as partners rather than building alone.

title: BOI approves TikTok's 842bn baht expansion
description: BOI approved 913bn baht in three data centre projects: TikTok System 842bn baht, DAMAC's Skyline 200MW and Bridge Data Centres 134MW.
actor: Thailand BOI; TikTok; DAMAC; Bridge Data Centres
significance: The largest data centre approval in Thai history went to a Chinese platform.

title: Bloomberg links Thai firm OBON to chip diversion
description: Bloomberg reported US officials suspect Bangkok-based OBON, linked to Siam AI's CEO, was the indictment's 'Company-1'; BIS has held shipments to it since Aug 2025.
actor: US BIS; OBON Corp; Siam AI
significance: Tied Thailand's flagship sovereign AI player to a US diversion probe.

title: NEPC approves separate data centre tariff
description: The National Energy Policy Council approved a separate tariff category for data centres, with a rate of about 5 to 6 baht/kWh expected, and a grid-access guarantee of 4.5m baht per MW.
significance: Thailand began pricing data centres above households for grid and LNG costs.

title: 1H 2026 applications reach 1.47tn baht
description: BOI said 1H 2026 applications hit 1.47tn baht (US$43.6bn), with the digital sector, including data centres, at about 1.12tn baht (US$33bn).
significance: Digital projects became three-quarters of all promoted investment.

title: Cabinet creates Data Centre Business Policy Committee
description: The Cabinet approved a PM's Office regulation creating a committee to set standards on energy, water, land, safety, data security and community harm.
significance: Created the first central authority over data centre approvals.

title: Grid-bond details reported
description: Local media reported details of the grid-access guarantee of 4.5m baht per MW approved on 15 Jul, with capacity reclaimed if not used within five to seven years.
significance: Aimed to purge speculative power reservations.

title: Draft PDP 2026 plans 50.9GW, 8.8GW for data centres
description: The draft PDP 2026 planned about 50.9GW of new capacity to 2037, mostly solar and batteries, with data centre demand up to 8.8GW in the high case.
significance: First national power plan to size data centre load explicitly.

title: Government pauses 49 data centres under construction
description: The new supervision board paused 49 data centres under construction and 117 awaiting approval while rules were drafted; 35 were operating.
actor: Data Centre supervision board (Finance Minister Ekniti)
significance: Thailand stopped more data centres than it had running, a rare host-state brake.

title: DAMAC Bangkok site found storing unlicensed diesel
description: Inspectors found about 200,000 litres of unlicensed backup diesel at DAMAC's Rama 9 data centre after odour complaints; a police complaint was filed.
significance: A concrete urban siting failure behind Bangkok's freeze and the new zoning rules.

title: Energy Ministry calls 35GW of requests phantom demand
description: The Energy Ministry said data centre power applications total 35GW against a 40GW national peak (metered record 36.8 GW), and proposed planning for 8.8GW.
significance: Quantified the gap between paper demand and what the grid will plan for.

title: Policy Committee approves seven-tier data centre framework
description: The Data Centre Policy Committee approved a draft with seven power tiers, a one-stop approval service, minimum standards and pitching rounds for new projects.
significance: Turned approvals from first-come to competitive screening on local benefit.

title: Cabinet endorses data centre rulebook
description: The Cabinet endorsed the framework: sites of 20MW or more must be in industrial estates, with generator noise, heat and water limits and economic-value screening, after over 30,000MW of overlapping power requests.
significance: Ended the open-door phase; future approvals depend on jobs, suppliers and clean power.
